issue_request: FHIR-6040 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 request to resolve apparent overlap between StructureDefinition metadata and the root ElementDefinition, including an invariant prohibiting root ElementDefinition.label, code, and requirements.
initial_application: Jira records SVN revision 5726 as the original application. Historical release artifacts show the broad sdf-9 prohibition carried forward, and current Git history inherited it through later source reworks before R6.
additional_context: FHIR-48326 is the later Applied/Persuasive R6 decision for the same invariant. It explicitly cites FHIR-6040, removes label and code from sdf-9 because current StructureDefinition no longer has true overlapping counterparts, and retains requirements because it still overlaps StructureDefinition.purpose. FHIR-48326 is already represented on the combined branch by b77eec34403a5bca4ac9f69b7ea8ca3e11286785.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit for FHIR-6040. No source edit was made because active build-scope source already has the requirements-only sdf-9 invariant and changing it back would contradict FHIR-48326.
